about: A /// note written as an XML comment (editor spec §24 note_standard; graph spec req:26.plain): what the core writes into a GraphML export and the Python library into an SCXML export, held to this one table by packages/core/test/xml-comment.test.js and python/graph_spec/tests/test_scxml.py, so both write the same comment for the same note and read it back the same. The comment is <!--, a space, the note's text, a space and -->. XML forbids -- inside a comment and a - at its end, and the only way out of a comment is -->, so a - directly after a - is written \-; a backslash is written \\, a carriage return \r (XML would make it a line feed), and a character XML 1.0 cannot hold \u{its code point in hexadecimal}. Nothing else is changed, so the comment reads back as the note, and its text can never end the comment. Each case has a stable id, the note's text and the comment written for it.
